description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 2 August 2019 under the slogan "New power for Pokémon and Trainers", with many Supporters. Its TAG TEAMs Solgaleo & Lunala-GX and Reshiram & Zekrom-GX gain extra effects when their player has used the Supporters Lillie's Full Force and N's Resolve, and Vileplume-GX and Silvally-GX join them. The set introduced the Character Rare, marked CHR: twelve Pokémon drawn together with a Trainer, such as Torkoal with Flannery. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 49, followed by the twelve Character Rare cards, full-art Super Rare cards in new illustrations, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Lana's Fishing Rod, Lillie's Poké Doll and Power Plant. In English some of its cards came out in Cosmic Eclipse in November 2019.
